session.hello: HELLO v2 (relay.py) with role 3 = ARENA member; want_seat 0..15 or 0xFF (any); flags bit0 = this console sends voice

ack_status.0: ok: byte 6 is my seat (0..15), stamped on everything I send
ack_status.2: bad request: from an ARENA HELLO this means the relay predates arena mode (an older relay rejects role 3); fall back
ack_status.3: version: this code is a version 1 session
ack_status.4: seat taken: the pinned seat is held; ask again with 0xFF
ack_status.5: wrong kind: this code is a hub or star session

session.seat_numbering: every 'seat' field in SYNE / SYNR is 0..15 (0xFF = none); SYNS held / eaten_by are seat+1 (0 = none), as plan 2.1 writes them
session.referee_clock: referee ms, u32, from a random base PER SEAT: every time a seat receives (SYNQ t_ref, SYNR header and event times) and every stamp it sends is in its own base; use them only relative to your own pongs
session.no_relay: arena mode needs a relay (a local relay copy for tests); the loopback mesh has no referee

kinds.note: object frame: a star in flight
12 = peer ping (as hub); 20 with byte 6 = 0xFE = referee clock ping
12 = peer pong (as hub); 20 = the referee's clock pong (from a seat: dropped)

fields: 0 none, 1..16 = seat+1 in my mouth, 0x20+ object
0 free, 1..16 = seat+1 whose mouth I am in
per seat, 1.., +1 per NEW claim, wraps skipping 0; a resend repeats it
referee ms of the touch, from my clock offset
my own match frame of the touch (my SYNS frames)
HIT / EAT: the victim's SYNS frame I was drawing (rounded down); else 0
t_ref of the newest referee pong I got, 0 = none
my ms between getting that pong and sending this ping; 0xFFFF = none
the referee's min RTT for this seat, 0xFFFF unknown

header: 0xFE (the referee); accept SYNR only from the relay with 0xFE here
newest event seq of the session stream, 0 = none yet
referee ms of match start, 0 = not started
THE LEDGER, per seat; mirror into data_0209f310
snapshot: high nibble part index, low nibble part count; else 0
event: 1.. per session (wraps skipping 0); 0 = snapshot record, not part of the stream

claims.name: READY
claims.fields: aux = time limit s (0 none); stamp = rules: b0 first_to_n, b1 mode (0 classic, 2 Luigi Infection; 1 is kept for King of the Star and refused, like every other value), b2 capacity 2..16, b3 marker count 1..8; my_frame = the go plan digest (u32, same on every console); ref_frame 0. Every console sends it once booted; config must match the first READY

claims.name: MARKER_BREAK
claims.fields: aux = the breaker's camera yaw (the ROM pop direction); stamp; my_frame

claims.name: HIT
claims.fields: aux = hitFlags >> 5 (F2 mask 0x27fe0); stamp; my_frame; ref_frame = the victim frame I drew

claims.name: HURT_SELF
claims.fields: aux = cause 1 chomp, 2 iron ball, 3 other; always accepted, spills one star; sanctions knockback speed for 2 s

claims.name: PIT
claims.fields: aux bit0 = this fall costs a star (the ROM St_DeadPit path); always accepted; sanctions the respawn teleport for 3 s

claims.name: QUIT
claims.fields: leaving now (clean exit): stars spill at once

claims.name: EAT
claims.fields: PROVISIONAL (A5): tongue on a puppet; ref_frame = victim frame drawn

claims.name: ESCAPE
claims.fields: PROVISIONAL (A5): victim got out on its own

claims.name: CATCH
claims.fields: GRAB1: Wario catches a stunned player (the ROM's Player::TryGrab); stamp; my_frame; ref_frame = the victim frame I drew

claims.name: THROW
claims.fields: GRAB1: let go / throw (vertical 0x10000); aux = my yaw (u16); ref_frame = launch speed (Fix12)

claims.name: SWING
claims.fields: GRAB1: the spin throw (vertical 0x20000); aux = launch yaw (u16); ref_frame = launch speed (Fix12)

claims.name: BREAK
claims.fields: GRAB1: the victim struggled free of a hold

claims.name: STOMP
claims.fields: GRAB1: I landed on a player (the ROM's func_ov002_020d869c stomp: JumpedOnByPlayer + func_ov002_020d9298); stamp; my_frame; ref_frame = the victim frame I drew

claims.name: CAP_TAKE
claims.target: cap id (1..31 a cap the arena places, 32..255 one a hit knocked off)
claims.fields: VSREF3: my body touched a cap and the ROM's pickup started; aux = the cap's place hash (placed caps: (slot & 0xFF) | ((x_units ^ z_units) & 0xFF) << 8, slot = the actor's death-table id, 0 for a knocked-off one); stamp; my_frame

claims.name: CAP_DROP
claims.target: the look (0 Mario, 1 Luigi, 2 Wario) of the cap that came off
claims.fields: VSREF3: my body was hurt and the ROM popped my cap (St_Hurt_Init -> func_ov002_020d93ac); aux = my angle Y (u16); ref_frame = my angle X (low 16) | my angle Z (high 16); my_frame = the frame it popped; the pop position is the referee's own sample of me

claims.name: TAG
claims.fields: LUIGI (mode 2 only): my Luigi body touched a survivor's body (Classic's team guard, unmatched/LuigiInfection_Hit.cpp, runs on any player contact, before the ROM's attack and stomp branches); stamp; my_frame; ref_frame = the victim frame I drew. A Luigi's HIT and STOMP infect too; TAG is for a touch that is neither

events.name: START
events.fields: seat 0xFF; a order row; b first_to_n; c time limit s; d roster; e marker count; t = T0 (match frame 0, in the future by COUNTDOWN_MS); x seed (u32); y map; z rules word (READY stamp)

events.name: STAR_WAKE
events.fields: seat 0xFF; a instance; b star id (VS_STAR_SPAWN_ORDERS[row][c]); c progress index p (data_0209f208); t now

events.name: MARKER_BROKEN
events.fields: seat breaker; a instance; b star id; c claim id; d camera yaw; t stamp; xyz breaker position (Fix12). The breaker's console launches the star (SYNO)

events.name: STAR_TAKEN
events.fields: seat winner; a instance; b winner's new score; c claim id; e progress after; t stamp; xyz winner position

events.name: DENY
events.fields: DIRECTED to the claimant only (seq 0, flag directed): seat claimant; a claim kind; b reason (DENY_*); c claim id; d winner seat when LOST else 0xFF; e target echo; t now

events.name: HIT
events.fields: seat victim; a attacker; b 0 hit / 1 trade; c attacker's claim id; d aux (hitFlags >> 5); e spilled instance (0 none); t stamp; xyz attacker position (Fix12) for Player::Hurt

events.name: CLASH
events.fields: seat victim; a attacker; c claim id; t stamp; xyz attacker position: both bounce, no star

events.name: SPILL
events.fields: seat who lost it (0xFF none); a new instance; b destination marker (referee RNG); c cause 1 hit 2 leave 3 hazard 4 pit; d that seat's new score; t now; xyz origin (Fix12)

events.name: MATCH_OVER
events.fields: seat 0xFF; a reason (OVER_*); b winner count; c winners mask; t end; the header ledger is final

events.name: LEAVE
events.fields: seat leaver; a 1 quit, 2 silent PRESENCE_MS, 3 relay detach; d stars spilled; t now

events.name: JOIN
events.fields: seat joiner; a 0 before start, 1 mid-match; t now

events.name: STAR_STATE
events.fields: SNAPSHOT ONLY (seq 0): seat 0xFF; a instance; b state 1 waking / 2 free; c marker; d star id; t since; xyz last known position

events.name: ACCEPTED
events.fields: DIRECTED to the claimant only (seq 0, flag directed): seat claimant; a claim kind; c claim id; d spilled instance or 0; t now (READY, HURT_SELF, PIT, QUIT)

events.name: EATEN
events.fields: PROVISIONAL (A5): seat victim; a eater; c claim id; t stamp; xyz eater position

events.name: RELEASED
events.fields: PROVISIONAL (A5): seat victim; a eater; b 1 spit 2 swallow 3 escape 4 leave; c claim id (SPIT / SWALLOW / ESCAPE; 0 for a leave); t now

events.name: GRABBED
events.fields: GRAB1: seat victim; a holder; c claim id (CATCH); t stamp; xyz holder position (Fix12)

events.name: THROWN
events.fields: GRAB1: seat victim; a holder; b 1 throw 2 swing 3 break 4 leave / forced; c claim id (THROW / SWING / BREAK; 0 for 4); d launch yaw (u16); t now; x launch speed (Fix12); yz 0

events.name: STOMPED
events.fields: GRAB1: seat victim; a stomper; c claim id; t stamp; xyz stomper position (Fix12). No star, no hurt: the ROM's squash and the stomper's bounce

events.name: CAP_TAKEN
events.fields: VSREF3: seat taker; a cap id; b look (0..2); c claim id; d ms until a placed cap is back (0 = a knocked-off cap never comes back); t stamp; xyz taker position. Every other console deletes its copy of the cap; the taker keeps the ROM's own pickup

events.name: CAP_DROPPED
events.fields: VSREF3: seat victim; a new cap id (32..255); b look (0..2); c claim id; d angle Y; e angle X (angle Z is 0 on the wire); t stamp; xyz pop position (Fix12, already the ROM's +0x82000 above the body). Every console but the victim's spawns the cap the ROM spawns (actor 0x10d, param (look << 8) | 5, speed 0xb000)

events.name: CAP_STATE
events.fields: SNAPSHOT ONLY (seq 0): seat 0xFF; a cap id; b 1 a placed cap that is taken / 2 a knocked-off cap lying there; c ms until the placed cap is back / the knocked-off one expires; d look; xyz last position

events.name: INFECTED
events.fields: LUIGI (mode 2): seat = the player who is a Luigi now; a by: the tagging Luigi's seat, 0xFF when the referee made it (pick, hand-off, late join); b cause (INF_*); c the tagger's claim id (HIT / STOMP / TAG), 0 when the referee made it; d the Luigi mask after (bit = seat); e survivors left in the match; t stamp (the first pick: T0); xyz the tagger's position (Fix12; 0 when the referee made it). No hurt, no star: swap the body to Luigi at once

events.name: TEAM_STATE
events.fields: SNAPSHOT ONLY (seq 0), mode 2: seat 0xFF; a 1 = the first Luigi is picked, 0 = not yet; c the Luigi mask; d the roster mask; t the pick time (T0)

deny_reasons.name: STALE
deny_reasons.note: match not running, or the claim is older than history

deny_reasons.name: GONE
deny_reasons.note: star missing / already taken / marker already broken

deny_reasons.name: LOST
deny_reasons.note: contested: another seat's earlier stamp won (d = winner)

deny_reasons.name: RANGE
deny_reasons.note: claimant / attacker too far from the target at that time

deny_reasons.name: STATE
deny_reasons.note: claimant hurt / in a mouth / no-control, or not attacking

deny_reasons.name: INVULN
deny_reasons.note: victim invincible, or already hit inside HIT_IMMUNE_MS

deny_reasons.name: MISMATCH
deny_reasons.note: READY config differs from the match

deny_reasons.name: UNSUPPORTED
deny_reasons.note: mode or claim kind not in this phase

deny_reasons.name: SELF
deny_reasons.note: target is the claimant, or not a seat in the match

deny_reasons.name: TEAM
deny_reasons.note: Luigi Infection team rule: a Luigi may not take a cap, drop one, eat or catch; a survivor may not take the Luigi cap or TAG

infect_causes.name: PICK
infect_causes.note: the first Luigi, picked at T0

infect_causes.name: HANDOFF
infect_causes.note: every Luigi left: the referee picked a new one

infect_causes.name: LATE_JOIN
infect_causes.note: a new player joined after the first pick

infect_causes.name: RETURN
infect_causes.note: a Luigi whose connection dropped came back on its seat within REJOIN_KEEP_MS

rules: The referee sends a seat nothing, and counts no claim from it, until the seat's clock ping (SYNP 20) echoes the exact t_ref of a referee pong it received (echo_ref) with held_ms = how long it held that pong. Ping at 2 Hz from the moment the seat is paired; the second ping verifies it. After that the referee sends a seat at most 3x the bytes the seat sends it (SYNS / SYNO / SYNE / SYNP, banked up to 16 KB): keep SYNS flowing (10 Hz idle is plenty) from pairing on, or heartbeats pause until you send again (every SYNR re-carries the 8 newest events).

Claims are decided in STAMP order once referee time passes stamp + H, H = the largest back-dating cap among the other seats in the match (<= HOLD_MAX_MS). Exact stamp ties: fewer stars first, then the match seed's seat order.
A stamp is clamped into [arrival - cap, arrival] (cap = min(HOLD_MAX_MS, rtt_min/2 + CAP_MARGIN_MS); CAP_UNKNOWN_MS before any clock ping); clamps are counted per seat.

Every claim (seat, claim_id) gets exactly one terminal event naming it: MARKER_BROKEN, STAR_TAKEN, HIT, CLASH, EATEN, RELEASED, GRABBED, THROWN, STOMPED, ACCEPTED or DENY. A resend after the verdict gets that same event again (directed if it left the 8-event window). DENY and ACCEPTED are directed records (seq 0) to the claimant alone, never in the stream; the others are stream events everyone hears. Resend a claim every CLAIM_RESEND_MS until named; no verdict in VERDICT_TIMEOUT_MS = treat as denied.

The claimant of an event: its seat for DENY, ACCEPTED, STAR_TAKEN and MARKER_BROKEN; its field a for HIT, CLASH and EATEN (seat = the victim); seat or a for RELEASED (escape: the victim; spit / swallow: the eater).

Every SYNR carries the 8 newest events (newest first). It goes out at once when events are made and as a HEARTBEAT_HZ heartbeat. Apply events in seq order exactly once and report the newest applied in SYNS.ack; a seat whose ack trails past the window gets the missed events again (directed, flag resend) while the referee still holds them, else a SNAPSHOT (directed SYNR parts, flag snapshot: START replay + STAR_STATE records + MATCH_OVER if over, seq 0); after the last part set applied = header newest_seq.
Every collect (order star or spilled star) advances progress p; the referee then wakes VS_STAR_SPAWN_ORDERS[row][p] as a new instance (STAR_WAKE), the ROM's own rule with the referee's row.
The ledger (header scores) is the only score. HIT = victim -1 and a SPILL (if it had any); leave / QUIT = all of that seat's stars spill; HURT_SELF and PIT (aux bit0) spill one.
MATCH_OVER only from the referee: first_to_n reached, referee time >= T0 + match_ms, one seat left of a match that had two or more, or everyone left. Winners = every seat on the top score.
A seat the referee dropped from the match (LEAVE naming itself) must send READY again to come back (JOIN mid-match, score 0, SNAPSHOT).

GRAB1 (the Wario hold): CATCH is a HIT-shaped claim from a Wario (SYNS character 2) in a punch or dive against a victim in the stun a Wario hit leaves (St_Hurt within GRAB_STUN_MAX_MS of that hit, or St_DizzyStars); verdict GRABBED (seat = victim, a = holder) or DENY. One hold per holder and per victim; a held seat cannot be hit or eaten. THROW and SWING (holder) and BREAK (victim) end a hold no sooner than GRAB_RELEASE_MIN_MS after the GRABBED, as THROWN (b 1 throw, 2 swing, 3 break, 4 forced: a leave, a quit, or the victim not in St_Grabbed for GRAB_STUCK_MS); the launch speed is capped at GRAB_SPEED_MAX. STOMP (GRAB1, F9-d): an airborne claimant falling onto a player in reach, STOMPED to everyone (the victim squashes, the stomper bounces); never a star, never a hurt; one per pair per STOMP_MIN_MS.

VSREF3 (caps): a cap the arena places has an id 1..31 (its death-table slot + 1: the arena's cap table) and a cap a hit knocks off has one the referee issues (32..255). CAP_TAKE is a claim like GRAB: the earliest stamp wins (DENY LOST d = winner for the others, GONE once the cap is not there), the claimant must be able to act (STATE) and within CAP_R of the cap (RANGE; a knocked-off cap flies and slides for CAP_FLIGHT_MS and gets CAP_FLIGHT_SLACK more, measured from its pop point). A taken placed cap is back CAP_RESPAWN_MS after the stamp, on every console from the event time; a knocked-off cap lies CAP_LIFE_MS. CAP_DROP is the hurt wearer's report that the ROM popped its cap: granted only to a seat whose own SYNS showed that cap look within CAP_WORN_MS and showed a hurt within CAP_HURT_EVIDENCE_MS, once per wearing; the pop position is the referee's own sample of the seat, never the claim's.

Modes: 0 classic and 2 Luigi Infection; any other READY mode (1 is kept for King of the Star) is DENY UNSUPPORTED. TAG outside a mode 2 match is an unknown kind, as before mode 2 existed: no verdict, a strike. EAT / SPIT / SWALLOW / ESCAPE are provisional for A5; speed strikes are logged, not kicked.

LUIGI INFECTION (mode 2; mode 0 never sees any of this). The start countdown is LUIGI_COUNTDOWN_MS instead of COUNTDOWN_MS; the referee freezes nobody during it (movement is the game's) and, as in every mode, decides no claim before T0 but QUIT (DENY STALE). At T0 the referee picks the first Luigi: sorted(roster)[seed % n], seed = START x, n = players in the match (Classic's port_luigi_seed rule), INFECTED b PICK. The team is the referee's alone (the Luigi mask). A Luigi is immune: a HIT, STOMP, EAT, CATCH or TAG on a Luigi is DENY INVULN, from anyone. A Luigi's HIT (attack state, reach, lag checks as a hit), STOMP (as a stomp) or TAG (body contact: TAG_REACH_H / TAG_REACH_V) on a survivor is INFECTED: no hurt, no star, and the victim's invincibility, power and hit-immunity do not stop it (Classic's guard runs before the ROM's resolution); so do its state: a survivor who is hurt, dead, respawning or squished is tagged too (Tango 11-09, 'tag anytime', a deliberate difference from Classic, whose resolver needs the victim's body collision on). A tag stamped before its tagger became a Luigi (before the pick at T0, or before its own INFECTED) is DENY STALE. A victim in a mouth or a hold is DENY INVULN. A Luigi's EAT, CATCH, CAP_TAKE and CAP_DROP are DENY TEAM; a survivor's CAP_TAKE of a Luigi cap (look 1) and a survivor's TAG are DENY TEAM. Survivor vs survivor is the classic rules. Infecting a player ends any hold or mouthful it is part of (THROWN b 4 / RELEASED b 4 first). Stars spill and score as in classic but decide nothing: first_to_n is ignored. The end: no survivor left in the match = LUIGIS_WIN (winners = the Luigis); the clock runs out with a survivor = SURVIVORS_WIN (winners = the survivors when the clock ran out, a survivor who left in the hold after it included, so the mask may name a seat no longer in the match); one player left of a match that had two or more = that player's team wins (5 or 6); everyone left = EVERYONE_LEFT. A mode 2 READY with capacity below 2 is DENY BAD. Leavers: the last Luigi leaves with two or more players left = the referee picks a new Luigi by the same rule over the players left (INFECTED b HANDOFF); the last survivor leaves = LUIGIS_WIN. Once the clock has run out (the hold before SURVIVORS_WIN) a leave changes nothing and nobody joins (Classic's hand-off stands down on the frozen end). Joiners: a seat that dropped WITHOUT a QUIT (silent PRESENCE_MS or relay detach) and sends READY again on the same seat number (the relay's seat reclaim) within REJOIN_KEEP_MS keeps its team: a survivor comes back a survivor (no INFECTED; its SNAPSHOT's TEAM_STATE leaves it out), a Luigi comes back a Luigi (INFECTED b RETURN). Cable dodge: a Luigi's HIT, STOMP or TAG on a survivor who dropped before it was decided counts when it would have counted with the survivor still there (the survivor's drawn sample no more than COMP_MAX_MS + one frame older than the touch, body contact reach): the tagger gets ACCEPTED, and the survivor, back on its seat within REJOIN_KEEP_MS, is a Luigi by that touch (INFECTED b TAG, HIT or STOMP, a = the tagger while it is still in the match). Any other player who joins after the pick is a Luigi at once (INFECTED b LATE_JOIN, before its SNAPSHOT); one who joins before the pick is in the pick. A mode 2 SNAPSHOT carries a TEAM_STATE record after the START replay.
